text: This report reviews and makes recommendations from a request by Kramer Design Associates (the "Applicant"), on behalf of the property owner, Bentall Kennedy, in respect of a third party sign variance application seeking to replace and consolidate three existing projecting signs, known as "B", "C" and "D", with a single larger electronic projecting sign; effectively, removing signs "B“ and “D”, currently displaying mechanical (tri‐vision) copy and static copy, respectively; and, increasing sign "C" to dimensions of 24.69 metres vertically by 31.55 metres horizontally, currently displaying electronic moving copy (the "Proposed Sign"). The subject premises is municipally known as 10 Dundas Street East (the "Premises") and is located within the Dundas Square Special Sign District ("DS-SSD") This report recommends that the Sign Variance Committee grant the variances required for the…

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Granted the variances requested to §694-26D(2), and Sections 4C(8)(c), 4C(8)(e), 4C(8)(f), 4C(9) & (10) of Schedule C, Additional Special Sign District Regulations to Chapter 694, Signs General required to allow the issuance of a permit for the erection and display of the third party electronic projecting sign (the "Proposed Sign"), as described in Attachment 1 of the report (June 29, 2018) from the Manager Sign By-law Unit, Toronto Building (the "June 29, 2018 Report") each subject to all of the conditions specified below: Condition A The sign shall not project less than 0.60 metres, nor more than 1.22 metres from the wall upon which it is erected. Condition B The sign shall be located in the location identified by the designation 'X', as indicated on the diagram, labelled as Diagram 1 - 10 Dundas Street East in the June 29, 2018 Report.
